name: The child
source:
He is the only son of a lawyer who defended a suspect in a case involving Xin Guang and won his acquittal.
When his father felt that he was in danger and the family was holed up in an abandoned house owned by a relative in Macau, they were attacked by Luk and Lan Yu, who were both members of the Web.
Luk attacked the family when the child was not home to save the child, but when the child returned home unscheduled, Lan Yu killed him to keep him quiet.
Luk's failure to protect him has been a heartbreak for him.
Yvet had a vision of the child during her stay in Macau.
